A '''mission''' was carried out by the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] to infiltrate a [[Aut-O's flagship/Legends|Aut-O's]] [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Providence-class carrier/destroyer]] where an [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] was held. The D-Squad hacked into [[C-Deck/Legends|C-Deck]] and made their way to a vault that carried the device. While inside the vault, [[Aut-O/Legends|Aut-O]] and multiple [[Droid/Legends|droids]] walked in and opened fire. Aut-O was later decapitated by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The D-Squad then escaped and made their way back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] with [[Escape from Abafar/Legends|some difficulties]].
